name: CHOPPAH
author: Laurens Profittlich
tagline: An Amen chopper for the FM-1
description: CHOPPAH turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an Amen break chopper. Eight classic Amen-family breaks are cut into sixteen slices on the white keys; hold a key to loop it. The black keys are momentary pads for rolls, reverse, freeze, tape stop, gate, filter and dub throws. A live generator rearranges the break, and a four-slot FX chain and a DJ filter sit behind it. Bluetooth audio sends the whole mix to a speaker or headphones.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
